release_notes: The Connect via TikTok MCP button now checks the panel address before contacting TikTok: on a plain http:// panel (including a bare IP) it shows a clear hint — add a domain with SSL on the Domains page and open the panel at https://your-domain — instead of failing with TikTok's cryptic "redirect_uris invalid" error. Verified against TikTok: HTTPS is the only hard requirement, even a bare-IP https:// address registers fine.
